rows.headline_text: Oil prices steady as investors weigh geopolitics, lower US stockpiles

Oct 21 (Reuters) - The dollar held steady against most major currencies on Wednesday as investors weighed developments ​in the Middle East conflict, which has revived demand for the US currency as a safe haven amid concerns about oil-driven ‌inflation.
